gamemechanicinfo-caveshrooms-text:
Caveshrooms
The world is in a constant state of flux, even far underground.

Unstable Substrate is the real organism - a slimy mat of unstable matter, thick with residual temporal instability, found deep underground. The Caveshroom mushroom is just its fruiting body.

Growth Cycle
A patch of substrate cycles through three states over time: Unstable Substrate, then Caveshroom Saddle, then finally Caveshroom. Harvesting a ripe caveshroom exchanges it back to bare substrate, ready to begin the cycle again - it never needs replanting.

Relocating
Unlike most mushrooms, the substrate itself can be dug up and carried. Break it (it always drops itself, regardless of growth state) and place it closer to a base to start a new patch.

Eating Caveshrooms
Caveshrooms are mildly poisonous and psychedelic - eat with some caution.

Alchemy
If the Alchemy mod is installed, a Caveshroom can be ground with a mortar and pestle alongside horsetail into a basic potion base.
